C-RU-ORG-GOVERNANCE.Summary: Continue the authorized Russian translation of the supporting corpus with the Organization guide, Unit governance guide and Unit governance workflow, and render their pages and dependent role and control profiles from those sources.

Goals.Goal: Provide complete professional Russian organizational and governance guidance grounded in the nine translated governing documents.
Keep roles, controls, RACI assignments, records, events and authority identical across languages and show the real Russian content on the portal.

Constraints.Constraint: The owner's proceed continues the existing corpus-first translation program and its established review and preview process. No language has automatic precedence.
Preserve source meaning, structure, identifiers, dates and decisions; protect unrelated work, including other portals.
Fix directly exposed localization defects at the existing renderer while retaining stable routes and page identities.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Change policy or operational facts, claim all supporting content translated, or fabricate human approval.
Commit, push or deploy this batch.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Three complete translations preserve all headings, table rows, diagram connections and RACI cells with consistent formal terminology and current source hashes.
Guide and workflow pages and generated role and control profiles use Russian source content with correct titles, language labels, references and search.
Existing source, unit, scaffolding and deterministic build checks pass; browser checks cover representative desktop and mobile pages and all generated profiles.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Semantic comparison, RACI and table alignment, complete diagrams and actual Russian profile rendering.
